title: A2's 'proven in a real run' has no evidence for either fault
body:
The local real-run record explicitly disclaims the mid-tool kill and container-loss proofs, and the post-merge cloud runbook (kkt) scores only A4. Nothing records a harness kill or a container loss inside a real epic run. Either inject a local harness kill mid-tool during a real local run, or extend docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md so the post-merge cloud run observes and records A2's real-run half. Otherwise the close-out should score A2's real-run clause as predicted.
evidence: docs/pi-durable-local-epic-run-2026-10-05.md 'Does not claim'; docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md (A4 only)
